Trial 31 ended in death.

**Outcome:** The screen reads "TRIAL END: DEATH" with the chat line "angelasq was slain by Zombie".

**What happened:**
- During the countdown a zombie was visible in the treetops ahead, but after the "FIGHT" banner it was no longer in view.
- I spent several turns rotating right to locate it. Each turn moved the camera only about 30 degrees, so the scan was slow.
- Health began dropping while nothing was on screen. By the time the zombie appeared at the right edge of the frame, health was already down to about four and a half hearts.
- Two attack swings while turning toward it did not land. The next screenshot showed the death screen, and no kill was observed.

**Input issue:** Camera rotation per action was small relative to the dx value sent, which made locating an off-screen attacker take too long. A faster initial sweep or an immediate shield raise when damage appeared would have been the better play.
